I built an Instantly alternative for people with no lead list yet (and when you should stay on Instantly)
If you're looking for an Instantly alternative, it's worth being clear about what Instantly is great at first, because for a lot of people the right move is to stay.

**What Instantly (and Smartlead) do well**

Cold email at volume: lots of sending accounts, warmup, inbox rotation, a shared inbox for replies. Instantly also has its own lead database. If you already know who to email and what to say, it's hard to beat on sending.

**Where people get stuck**

Sending was never the hard part. The hard part is deciding who to email this week, and what reason you have to email them. A bigger list and more inboxes don't answer that.

That's the gap I built Startories for. Instead of starting from a list, it starts from a buying signal: someone on Reddit or X asking for a tool, a complaint about a competitor, a Product Hunt launch, a hiring post, a funding round. Then it matches the company, checks your ICP, verifies the decision-maker's email, writes around the event, and sends from warmed-up inboxes with a low daily cap.

|Instantly / Smartlead|Startories|
|:-|:-|
|Starts from|Your list (or their lead database)|
|Best at|Sending volume and deliverability infrastructure|
|Writing|Your templates and sequences|
|Volume|Thousands a day across many inboxes|
|You need|A list and copy that already work|

**Stay on Instantly if**

* You have a list and a message that already get replies
* You need high volume across many inboxes
* Someone on your team owns copy and list building

**Look elsewhere if**

* You keep buying lists that don't reply
* You're a founder doing sales part-time, and list building is the step you never get to

\-> More inboxes fix sending limits, not targeting

\-> Same logic if you're shopping for a Smartlead alternative: first decide whether your problem is sending or targeting

\-> Caveat: a signal-first tool sends far fewer emails. If your model needs volume, it's the wrong trade

  
Here's the project: [startories.com](https://startories.com),  
Longer comparison, with other Instantly alternatives too: [startories.com/alternatives/instantly](https://startories.com/alternatives/instantly). Starter is $99/month, and the first project is free for 7 days.
